newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Telebras phone lines grow in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Telebras phone lines grow in 1996.

text.p: Brazil's state-owned telecommunications firm Telebras said it installed 2.9 million new telephone lines in 1996.
Of that total, 1.581 million were conventional lines and 1.286 million were cellular lines, it added.
Heavy line growth was one of the factors behind Telebras' 1996 earnings.

Telebras reported a net consolidated profit of 2.756 billion reais last year, while its holding company showed a 3.254 billion reais net profit in the period. ((--Fatima Cristina, Sao Paulo Newsroom, 5511 2485412))
